sentences.en: The year has four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
Spring came and the weather became warm.
Flowers started to grow and the grass became green.
Summer was the warmest season of the year.
sentences.zh: 夏天是一年中最温暖的季节。

sentences.en: The sun was strong and the days were long.
The rain kept the plants alive.
sentences.zh: 雨水维持着植物的生命。

sentences.en: In autumn, the leaves on the trees turned red and yellow.
sentences.zh: 秋天，树上的叶子变成了红色和黄色。

sentences.en: The wind became stronger and the air was cooler.
sentences.zh: 风变大了，空气更凉爽了。

sentences.en: Then winter came. The air was cold and dry.
sentences.zh: 然后冬天来了。空气又冷又干燥。

sentences.en: Snow fell from the sky and everything became white.
sentences.zh: 雪从天空落下，一切都变成了白色。

sentences.en: The children played in the snow and had a great time.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在雪地里玩耍，玩得非常开心。

sentences.en: Each season had its own beauty.
sentences.zh: 每个季节都有它自己的美丽。

sentences.en: I loved spring the most because of the flowers.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢春天，因为花朵。

sentences.en: The growth of the plants was clear in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天植物的生长很明显。

sentences.en: The force of the wind in the storm was strong.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨中风的力量很强。

sentences.en: The increase in temperature made us take off our coats.
sentences.zh: 温度升高让我们脱掉了外套。
